title: Definitions
description: The glossary: the definitions of terms in the Ubiquitous Language

DefinitionId.description: The stable handle for citing the definition

Definition.description: A Term in the Ubiquitous Language, named by its id, with its specification, optional partOfSpeech and surface forms, optional References, and optional closed or open enumeration

ClosedEnumeration.description: Every narrower definition of the term, by id. Each listed definition is a kind of the term, and nothing outside the list is. A definition is either a closed or an open enumeration, never both

OpenEnumeration.description: Narrower definitions of the term known so far, by id. Each listed definition is a kind of the term, and other kinds may exist that are not listed. A definition is either a closed or an open enumeration, never both

Enumeration.description: The ids of the narrower definitions a term enumerates, each listed once. A listed definition does not restate the term in its own specification

Specification.description: The precise meaning of the term in Ubiquitous Language (uql)

definitions.specification: Boundary across which two Software Elements interact.
